name: List all targets
description: List all targets Lists and sorts an account's targets. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/infrastructure/targets
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/infrastructure/targets
Lists and sorts an account's targets. Filters are optional and are ANDed together.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: hostname (query) — Hostname of a target; hostname_contains (query) — Partial match to the hostname of a target; virtual_network_id (query) — Private virtual network identifier of the target; ip_v4 (query) — IPv4 address of the target; ip_v6 (query) — IPv6 address of the target; created_before (query) — Date and time at which the target was created before (inclusive); created_after (query) — Date and time at which the target was created after (inclusive); modified_before (query) — Date and time at which the target was modified before (inclusive); modified_after (query) — Date and time at which the target was modified after (inclusive); ips (query) — Filters for targets that have any of the following IP addresses. Specify `ips` multiple times in query parameter to build list of candidates.; target_ids (query) — Filters for targets that have any of the following UUIDs. Specify `target_ids` multiple times in query parameter to build list of candidates.; ip_like (query) — Filters for targets whose IP addresses look like the specified string. Supports `*` as a wildcard character; ipv4_start (query) — Defines an IPv4 filter range's starting value (inclusive). Requires `ipv4_end` to be specified as well.; ipv4_end (query) — Defines an IPv4 filter range's ending value (inclusive). Requires `ipv4_start` to be specified as well.; ipv6_start (query) — Defines an IPv6 filter range's starting value (inclusive). Requires `ipv6_end` to be specified as well.; ipv6_end (query) — Defines an IPv6 filter range's ending value (inclusive). Requires `ipv6_start` to be specified as well.; tag (query) — Filter by tag key:value pairs. Multiple `tag` params are AND'd. Format: `tag=key:value` (e.g., `tag=environment:production`). Key and value must both be non-empty; `tag=:value` and `tag=key:` return 400.; page (query) — Current page in the response; per_page (query) — Max amount of entries returned per page; order (query) — The field to sort by.; direction (query) — The sorting direction.
